hypothesis: A per-user listwise softmax fine-tune is more directly aligned with within-user ranking than pointwise BCE or sampled BPR: for each training user with both positive and negative impressions, optimize logsumexp(scores_for_user) minus the mean positive score. BCE warmup supplies a good FM initialization and checkpointing prevents harmful fine-tuning from replacing it.
